import Mathlib

theorem exists_injective_map
    {R : Type u} {M : Type v} {N : Type w} [Semiring R]
    [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M] [Module.Free R M]
    [AddCommMonoid N] [Module R N] (s : Set N) (hi : LinearIndepOn R id s)
    (h : Cardinal.lift.{w} (Module.rank R M) ≤ Cardinal.lift.{v} (Cardinal.mk s)) :
    ∃ f : M →ₗ[R] N, Function.Injective f := by
  obtain _ | _ := subsingleton_or_nontrivial M
  · exact ⟨0, Function.injective_of_subsingleton _⟩
  have := Module.nontrivial R M
  obtain ⟨c, ⟨bb⟩⟩ := Module.Free.exists_set R M
  replace h :=
    (Cardinal.lift_le.2 bb.linearIndependent.cardinal_le_rank).trans h
  rw [Cardinal.lift_mk_le'] at h
  obtain ⟨i⟩ := h
  let m := i.trans (.subtype _)
  have hm : LinearIndependent R m :=
    hi.linearIndependent.comp i i.injective
  refine ⟨bb.constr ℕ m, ?_⟩
  -- why is this not in mathlib
  rw [← bb.repr.symm.injective_comp]
  intro a b hab
  apply hm.finsuppLinearCombination_injective
  simpa [Module.Basis.constr_def] using hab

theorem exists_linearIndepOn_of_rank_lt
    {R : Type u} {α : Cardinal.{v}} {M : Type w} [Semiring R]
    [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M]
    (h : Cardinal.lift.{w} α < Cardinal.lift.{v} (Module.rank R M)) :
    ∃ s : Set M, Cardinal.lift.{v} (Cardinal.mk s) = Cardinal.lift.{w} α ∧
                 LinearIndepOn R id s := by
  rcases Cardinal.lt_lift_iff.mp h with ⟨α', hα', hαα'⟩
  rcases exists_lt_of_lt_ciSup (by simpa [← hαα', Module.rank_def] using h) with ⟨⟨s, hs⟩, h⟩
  rcases Cardinal.le_mk_iff_exists_subset.mp h.le with ⟨t, hst, ht⟩
  exact ⟨t, by simp [ht, hαα'], hs.mono hst⟩

theorem Module.Basis.injective_constr_of_linearIndependent {R M N ι : Type*}
    [Semiring R] [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M] [AddCommMonoid N] [Module R N]
    (B : Basis ι R M) (v : ι → N) (hv : LinearIndependent R v) : Injective (B.constr ℕ v) := by
  rw [← B.repr.symm.injective_comp]
  intro a b hab
  apply hv.finsuppLinearCombination_injective
  simpa [Module.Basis.constr_def] using hab

theorem Module.Free.exists_linearMap_injective_of_linearIndependent
    {R : Type u} {M : Type v} {N : Type w} [Semiring R]
    [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M] [Module.Free R M] [AddCommMonoid N] [Module R N]
    {ι : Type w} (v : ι → N) (hv : LinearIndependent R v)
    (h : Cardinal.lift.{w} (Module.rank R M) ≤ Cardinal.lift.{v} (Cardinal.mk ι)) :
    ∃ f : M →ₗ[R] N, Function.Injective f := by
  rcases subsingleton_or_nontrivial M with _ | _
  · exact ⟨0, Function.injective_of_subsingleton _⟩
  have := Module.nontrivial R M
  rcases Module.Free.exists_set R M with ⟨c, ⟨bb⟩⟩
  replace h := (Cardinal.lift_le.2 bb.linearIndependent.cardinal_le_rank).trans h
  rw [Cardinal.lift_mk_le'] at h
  rcases h with ⟨i, hi⟩
  refine ⟨bb.constr ℕ (v ∘ i), bb.injective_constr_of_linearIndependent _ (hv.comp _ hi)⟩

theorem Module.Free.exists_linearMap_injective_of_linearIndepOn
    {R : Type u} {M : Type v} {N : Type w} [Semiring R]
    [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M] [Module.Free R M]
    [AddCommMonoid N] [Module R N] (s : Set N) (hs : LinearIndepOn R id s)
    (h : Cardinal.lift.{w} (Module.rank R M) ≤ Cardinal.lift.{v} (Cardinal.mk s)) :
    ∃ f : M →ₗ[R] N, Function.Injective f :=
  exists_linearMap_injective_of_linearIndependent _ hs.linearIndependent h

theorem Module.exists_set_linearIndepOn_of_rank_lt
    {R : Type u} {α : Cardinal.{v}} {M : Type w} [Semiring R]
    [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M]
    (h : Cardinal.lift.{w} α < Cardinal.lift.{v} (Module.rank R M)) :
    ∃ s : Set M, Cardinal.lift.{v} (Cardinal.mk s) = Cardinal.lift.{w} α ∧
                 LinearIndepOn R id s := by
  rcases Cardinal.lt_lift_iff.mp h with ⟨α', hα', hαα'⟩
  rcases exists_lt_of_lt_ciSup (by simpa [← hαα', Module.rank_def] using h) with ⟨⟨s, hs⟩, h⟩
  rcases Cardinal.le_mk_iff_exists_subset.mp h.le with ⟨t, hst, ht⟩
  exact ⟨t, by simp [ht, hαα'], hs.mono hst⟩

theorem Module.Free.exists_linearMap_injective_of_rank_lt
    {R : Type u} {M : Type v} {N : Type w} [Semiring R]
    [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M] [Module.Free R M]
    [AddCommMonoid N] [Module R N]
    (h : Cardinal.lift.{w} (Module.rank R M) < Cardinal.lift.{v} (Module.rank R N)) :
    ∃ f : M →ₗ[R] N, Function.Injective f := by
  rcases exists_set_linearIndepOn_of_rank_lt h with ⟨s, hs, hs₂⟩
  exact Free.exists_linearMap_injective_of_linearIndepOn s hs₂ hs.symm.le

theorem Module.Free.exists_linearMap_injective_of_rank_le
    {R : Type u} {M : Type v} {N : Type w} [Semiring R] [StrongRankCondition R]
    [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M] [Module.Free R M]
    [AddCommMonoid N] [Module R N] [Module.Free R N]
    (h : Cardinal.lift.{w} (Module.rank R M) ≤ Cardinal.lift.{v} (Module.rank R N)) :
    ∃ f : M →ₗ[R] N, Function.Injective f := by
  rcases Module.Free.exists_set R N with ⟨c, ⟨B⟩⟩
  exact exists_linearMap_injective_of_linearIndependent _ B.linearIndependent
    (B.mk_eq_rank''.symm ▸ h)
